Full layouts of folio, page, virtual area, anonymous reverse map structure and address space beyond fields observed here.
Page table walk search algorithm and locking protocol for table traversal beyond finish and restart helpers.
Reference, unmap and clean behaviour when reverse mapping support is enabled.
Secret memory operations object and activation conditions beyond fallback false reporting.
Huge page sizes, page table level enumeration values and quota enforcement semantics.
Return contracts and accounting of multi page add helpers not shown in these fragments.

findings.text: Offers routines to initialise, raise and lower the aggregate mapping tally for a large compound memory unit, including variants that report the updated tally and single step helpers. One build keeps only the aggregate tally, while another also records up to two address space identities with per identity tallies and a shared marker.

Mutation of the aggregate tally together with the address space identity slots and the shared indicator is serialised by a single bit lock stored in the folio state. Callers acquire this lock before adjusting counts or slots and release it afterwards, so concurrent mapping changes in different address spaces do not interleave.

Unmapped state is represented by negative one, so a fresh tally is stored one below the requested mapping number. Large tracking applies only to large non huge TLB units with a positive adjustment and an identity inside the allowed range. A slot holding the dummy identity must carry negative one, otherwise it must be non negative, and an unmapped unit must not show the shared marker. The page span of the unit must fit the per identity maximum so a full single space mapping stays recognisable as exclusive.

Reverse mapping changes reject huge TLB and zero units, require a positive span fully inside the same unit, and require the level to be small page, middle directory or upper directory. Middle and upper directory levels denote one whole mapping whose span equals the corresponding huge page size.
Middle directory duplication expects a transparent huge page sized span, with sanity logic tying middle and upper directory levels to their respective huge page sizes.
Mapped anonymous units outside same page merging must keep their anonymous reverse map structure alive with a non zero reference count, checked during reverse mapping validation.

Walk cursor for locating a physical range inside one virtual area. It carries pfn, nr_pages, pgoff, vma, address, pmd, pte, ptl, flags and pgoff_is_anon, where the last is a one bit tag and pgoff is meaningful only for multi page non same page merging walks.

Control block for scanning all mappings of a unit. It holds arg, try_lock, contended, rmap_one, done, anon_lock and invalid_vma, where the first three are data and flags and the rest are callbacks for visiting one mapping, finishing, choosing the anonymous lock and filtering areas.
Completion helper for the walk cursor releases any mapped table entry except for huge TLB areas and releases the table lock when held.
Restart helper for the walk cursor expects some table position to be active, releases the table lock when held, and clears the lock and table position pointers to allow a fresh lookup.
Macro helper builds a walk cursor from a folio, virtual area, address and flags by deriving frame number, page count, file offset and anonymity from the folio.

Per space tracking uses two identity slots plus a shared flag. Adding mappings reuses the slot already holding the caller identity, otherwise claims a dummy slot for the new identity and raises shared when other mappings exist, otherwise leaves slots unchanged while still raising the aggregate tally. On narrow builds an overflowing per identity tally is discarded and shared is raised. Removing mappings lowers the matching slot and discards it when it becomes negative, then clears shared whenever either surviving slot tally equals the aggregate tally, which also covers the fully unmapped case.

File mapping duplication for copy operations validates the range and level, then accounts the new mappings. Small page level on small units bumps the single tally, on large units bumps per page tallies when configured and the large aggregate tally. Middle and upper directory levels bump the whole mapping tally and the large tally by one.

Anonymous mapping duplication for copy operations refuses with busy when a pinned exclusive page would be copied while direct memory access pinning is possible, otherwise clears exclusivity on encountered pages and accounts new mappings like the file path. Transparent huge page builds support middle directory duplication, other builds warn and refuse. Huge TLB anonymous duplication clears exclusivity unless pinning requires busy, then bumps whole and large tallies.

Anonymous sharing helpers attempt to drop exclusivity from a single page entry or a whole huge page mapping, returning busy when pinning is detected. Device private units drop exclusivity without pin checks. Transparent huge page builds support middle directory sharing, other builds warn and refuse. Huge TLB sharing follows the same pin check and exclusivity drop with ordering barriers on fast pin builds.
Single entry conveniences forward to the multi entry forms with a span of one for adding anonymous mappings, adding file mappings and removing mappings.
Huge TLB file accounting bumps or drops the whole mapping tally and the large tally together, with checks that the unit is huge TLB and non anonymous for addition.

Secret memory helpers report whether an address space or virtual area uses secret memory and whether the facility is active. One configuration tests the address space operations against the secret memory operations, while the fallback configuration reports false for all three queries.

When reverse mapping support is disabled, anonymous initialisation is a no operation, preparation reports success, reference checking clears output flags and reports unreferenced, unmapping does nothing, and clean marking reports no work.

On narrow builds repeated mappings of a large unit into one space can overflow the per space tally into negative values, and copy patterns with no free slot can later underflow a per space tally on unmapping. The design contains both by discarding the affected slot to dummy with negative one and marking shared, rather than keeping a corrupt count.

Dropping anonymous exclusivity races with fast page pinning that samples the table entry, pins, rechecks the entry and then checks exclusivity. Correctness relies on barrier pairing around the pin possibility test and after clearing exclusivity when fast pinning is available, plus never restoring writability for a possibly shared anonymous page.
The none reverse mapping flag is the zero value of the distinct reverse mapping type.
The exclusive reverse mapping flag is the lowest bit of the distinct reverse mapping type, numeric value one.
Reverse mapping flags use a distinct checked integer type based on plain integer, so mixing with plain integers needs explicit conversion.
Synchronous walk flag occupies the lowest bit, numeric value one.
Migration walk flag occupies the second bit, numeric value two.
Page table crossed walk flag occupies bit sixteen, numeric value sixty five thousand five hundred thirty six.
Shared memory maximum quota count is numeric value two.
Header inclusion guards for secret memory and shared memory filesystem headers are defined to mark single inclusion.
